title: Arthur Webb
intro:
Arthur Webb (No party preference) is running for election to the California State Assembly to represent District 15. He is on the ballot in the general election on November 3, 2026. He advanced from the primary on June 2, 2026.
Webb completed Ballotpedia's Candidate Connection survey in 2026. Click here to read the survey answers.
